name: Problem and solution
description: Show an everyday problem your audience recognises, then the product solving it.

scenes.label: Problem
scenes.visualDirection: A relatable everyday frustration — no product yet.
scenes.promptScaffold: {audienceWho} in {setting}, visibly dealing with a small everyday inconvenience that a {categoryNoun} would solve. {camera}. {lighting}. {toneMood}.

scenes.label: Frustration beat
scenes.visualDirection: A quick beat that lands the problem.
scenes.promptScaffold: Close-up of {audienceWho} reacting to the inconvenience in {setting}. {camera}. {lighting}. {toneMood}.

scenes.label: Product appears
scenes.visualDirection: The real product enters as the answer.

scenes.label: Solution in use
scenes.visualDirection: The product solving the problem in a real moment.
scenes.promptScaffold: {audienceWho} easily using {appearance} in {setting}, the problem solved. {camera}. {lighting}. {toneMood}.

scenes.label: Benefit
scenes.visualDirection: Hold on the product while a second benefit lands.

scenes.label: Call to action
scenes.visualDirection: Product with offer and call to action.
